excerpt_zh: 艺术墙面涂装 — Remmers，适合吉隆坡与雪兰莪装修项目。
excerpt_en: German Remmers artistic wall coating options for feature walls and selected interior spaces.
content_zh:
艺术墙面涂装适合想让空间更有质感的特色墙和部分室内空间。

正式建议方案前，我们会先确认墙面状态、设计方向、颜色、样板效果、维护需求和现场限制。
content_en:
Artistic wall coating is suitable for feature walls and selected interiors that need texture, depth, and a more distinctive finish than regular paint.

Before recommending a coating approach, we confirm wall condition, design direction, color, sample effect, maintenance expectations, and site constraints.
suitable_for_zh: 想提升质感的住宅业主

process_steps_zh.desc: 先看样板，再决定颜色和质感。
process_steps_zh.title: 咨询与选色

process_steps_zh.desc: 把墙面整理到适合施工的状态。
process_steps_zh.title: 墙面准备

process_steps_zh.desc: 先做试样，确认最终效果。
process_steps_zh.title: 试样确认

process_steps_zh.desc: 由施工团队逐层手工完成。
process_steps_zh.title: 正式施工

process_steps_zh.desc: 最后加封层保护，方便清洁与耐用。
process_steps_zh.title: 封层保护

process_steps_en.desc: We show physical samples and recommend coatings that suit your space and style.
process_steps_en.title: Consultation & Color Selection

process_steps_en.desc: We prepare the wall surface — cleaning, priming, and ensuring the substrate is ready.
process_steps_en.title: Surface Preparation

process_steps_en.desc: We apply a test patch on-site so you can approve the actual finish.
process_steps_en.title: Sample Application

process_steps_en.desc: Our trained technicians apply the coating by hand — each layer carefully worked.
process_steps_en.title: Full Application

process_steps_en.desc: The finished surface is sealed for durability and easy cleaning.
process_steps_en.title: Sealing & Protection

faqs_zh.a: 它是一种有质感的装饰涂装，能做出纹理、层次和特别的视觉效果。
耐用度会受墙面状态、涂装类型、施工方式、封层和日常使用影响，施工前应先确认维护要求。
费用会根据面积、效果、墙面处理、层数和现场情况变化，需要看过墙面和需求后确认报价。

faqs_en.a: Artistic wall coating is a decorative finish that can create texture, depth, and distinctive visual effects on selected walls.
Durability depends on wall condition, coating type, application method, sealing, and daily use. Maintenance needs should be confirmed before work starts.
Cost depends on wall area, selected finish, surface preparation, number of layers, and site condition. A quotation should be confirmed after reviewing the wall.
